retention_helper.source:
"""Local-only compact retention of the zero-call output-root launch repair."""
import difflib
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path

TASK=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO=TASK.parents[2]
WORK=TASK/'policy-gates'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('linux_retention',TASK/'retain-gates-qualification-linux.py')
ret=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(ret)
sha,normalize,dumps=ret.sha,ret.normalize,ret.dumps
hashes={}

def read(name):
    path=WORK/name;hashes[name]=sha(path)
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def htext(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()

def account(text):
    fields={}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        p=line.split(None,1)
        if len(p)==2:
            assert p[0] not in fields
            fields[p[0]]=p[1].strip()
    return fields

def main():
    deployment=read('qualification-output-repair-deployment.json')
    assert deployment['status']=='verified_all_24_tasks_held'
    assert all(o['exit']==0 for o in deployment['operations'])
    preflight=json.loads(deployment['operations'][-1]['stdout'])
    assert preflight['source_hashes_verified']==20 and preflight['canonical_containment']
    assert preflight['absent_outputs']==24 and preflight['native_calls']==0
    failures=read('qualification-output-path-failures.json')
    assert {(str(x['job']),x['task']) for x in failures}=={('8247991',4),('8247997',22),('8248000',31)}
    compact=[]
    allaccount=[]
    for filename in ['qualification-output-path-failure-accounting.json','qualification-output-path-failure-accounting-final.json','qualification-output-path-failure-accounting-third.json']:
        value=read(filename)
        allaccount.extend(value if isinstance(value,list) else [value])
    for f in failures:
        assert f['log_exists'] and not f['output_exists']
        assert 'ValueError: outputs belong under <target-tmp>/<task>' in f['log']
        assert 'NATIVE_SECONDS=' not in f['log']
        matching=[account(x['stdout']) for x in allaccount if x['exit']==0 and x['stdout'].strip()]
        a=next(x for x in matching if x['jobnumber']==str(f['job']) and x['taskid']==str(f['task']))
        assert a['failed']=='0' and a['exit_status']=='1' and a['slots']=='28'
        assert int(a['ru_wallclock'])=={4:4,22:6,31:4}[f['task']]
        compact.append({'job_id':str(f['job']),'task_id':f['task'],'replica':f['replica'],
                        'log_sha256':htext(f['log']),'error':'outputs belong under <target-tmp>/<task>',
                        'output_exists':False,'native_calls':0,'observations':0,'accounting':a})
    submissions=read('qualification-output-repair-submissions.json')
    assert len(submissions['accepted'])==3 and len(submissions['unchanged_held_tasks'])==21
    for job in submissions['accepted']:
        assert job['application_budget_s']==3600-job['failed_wallclock_s']
        assert job['scheduler_budget_s']==4200-job['failed_wallclock_s']
        f=next(f for f in compact if f['job_id']==job['failed_job_id'])
        assert job['array_tasks']==[f['task_id']] and job['hostname']==f['accounting']['hostname']
    expected_ids={'8250715','8250716','8250717'}
    assert {x['job_id'] for x in submissions['accepted']}==expected_ids
    mapping=[{k:j[k] for k in ['job_id','replica','array_tasks','hostname','scheduler_budget_s']}
             | {'application_budget_s':j.get('application_budget_s',3600)} for j in deployment['jobs']]
    assert sum(len(x['array_tasks']) for x in mapping)==24
    assert sum(len(x['array_tasks'])*x['application_budget_s'] for x in mapping)==86386
    link=read('qualification-output-path-repair.json')
    assert link['exit']==0
    link_result=json.loads(link['stdout'])
    assert link_result['failed_task_outputs_absent']==3 and link_result['source_edits']==link_result['native_calls']==0
    read('qualification-output-path-failure-hold.json')
    descriptor=read('qualification-allocation-amendment.json')
    for name in ['original_plan','amended_plan']:
        path=WORK/descriptor[name]['path'];assert sha(path)==descriptor[name]['sha256'];hashes[path.name]=sha(path)
    allocation=REPO/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-gates-allocation-20261022.json'
    assert sha(allocation)=='3325e78c2e60f84ea71538a3afca427ba5713387adb16d2a4f3d628cb010a993'
    old=json.loads(allocation.read_text())['launcher']['source']
    current=(TASK/'qualification-mpi-dispatch.sh').read_text()
    assert htext(current)==deployment['new_sha256'] and current==deployment['source']
    assert deployment['old_sha256']==json.loads(allocation.read_text())['launcher']['amended_sha256']
    checks=[]
    p=TASK/'setup1-review/checks/gates-output-repair-deployment.json';v=json.loads(p.read_text())
    assert sha(p.with_suffix('.log'))==v['log_sha256'];assert v['exit']==0
    checks.append({k:v[k] for k in ['label','command','exit','elapsed_s','log_sha256']})
    # The source contains a serialized raw-failure input assignment. Retain code
    # separately from that input, binding its original complete source hash.
    code_lines=link['source'].splitlines(True)
    omitted=[i for i,line in enumerate(code_lines) if line.startswith('failures=json.loads(')]
    assert len(omitted)==1
    link_excerpt=''.join(line if i not in omitted else '# Bound failures input omitted; parsed fields retained above.\n'
                         for i,line in enumerate(code_lines))
    record={'schema':1,'kind':'two-fe-policy-gates-zero-call-launch-repair','status':deployment['status'],
        'release_status':'held_at_verified_deployment; no repaired release asserted by this record',
        'scope':'One bounded operational replacement per pre-native launcher failure; no scientific/timing retry, new sampling or source/protocol/artifact change.',
        'allocation_record':{'file':allocation.name,'sha256':sha(allocation)},
        'failed_attempts':compact,'accounting_lookups':[ret.compact_operation(x) for x in allaccount],
        'repair':{'result':link_result,'source_guard_unchanged':"output.is_relative_to((ROOT / 'target/tmp').resolve())",
                  'before':'Amended ROOT target/tmp did not contain the original archive output root; guard rejected before mkdir/result construction/native execution.',
                  'after':'Only amended target/tmp symlink now resolves to original archive target/tmp; broader task root remains outside it.',
                  'original_source_sha256':htext(link['source']),'source_excerpt':link_excerpt},
        'replacement_jobs':submissions['accepted'],'unchanged_held_tasks':submissions['unchanged_held_tasks'],
        'actual_task_mapping':mapping,'budgets':{'original_application_per_task_s':3600,'failed_elapsed_deduction_s':14,
            'remaining_application_sum_s':86386,'original_scheduler_per_task_s':4200,
            'external_timeout_cleanup_grace_s':10,'grace_scope':'kill/reap only; not additional sampling permission'},
        'submission_parser_failure':submissions['submission_parser_failure'],
        'submission_operations':[ret.compact_operation(x) for x in submissions['operations']],
        'deployment':{'operations':[ret.compact_operation(x) for x in deployment['operations']],
                      'preflight_source':deployment['preflight_source'],'preflight_result':preflight},
        'launcher':{'before_sha256':deployment['old_sha256'],'after_sha256':deployment['new_sha256'],
                    'source':current,'normalized_unified_diff':''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True),normalize(current).splitlines(True),fromfile='previous-dispatch.sh',tofile='repaired-dispatch.sh'))},
        'unchanged_bindings':{'plans':descriptor,'execution_sources_changed':0,'native_artifacts_changed':0,'harness_changed':False},
        'additional_failure':{'kind':'initial sandbox network denial','effect':'No remote operation performed by denied attempt; later authorized deployment succeeded.','evidence':'tool trace only','log_sha256':None},
        'checks':checks,'input_sha256':hashes,
        'limitations':['Three original jobs remain failed despite zero observations; replacements are separate identities.',
            'This record establishes held deployment and actual-module preflight, not completed qualification or performance success.',
            'Raw logs/private paths are excluded; original hashes bind unsanitized bytes. Accounting fields and failure summaries are retained.',
            'Replacement release and eventual native outcomes must be separately retained.'],
        'normalization':{'source':inspect.getsource(ret.normalize), 'root_substitution_source':inspect.getsource(ret.encoder.clean), 'linux_helper_sha256':sha(TASK/'retain-gates-qualification-linux.py'), 'encoder_sha256':sha(TASK/'retain-gates-qualification-mac.py')},
        'retention_helper':{'sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'source':Path(__file__).read_text()}}
    data=dumps(normalize(record))+'\n';assert len(data.encode())<1_000_000
    for token in ['/'+'Users/','/'+'projectnb/','/'+'usr2/faculty/','/'+'usr4/','target/'+'tmp/']:
        assert token not in data,(token,data[max(0,data.find(token)-120):data.find(token)+180])
    path=REPO/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-gates-launch-repair-20261022.json'
    assert not path.exists() or path.read_text()==data,'refuse unequal overwrite'
    if not path.exists():path.write_text(data)
    print(json.dumps({'file':path.name,'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(path),'failed_zero_call_attempts':3,'held_tasks':24}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
